grants.title: Hazard Mitigation Grants
grants.summary: This grant funds projects aimed at reducing and eliminating the effects of disasters in Pennsylvania.
grants.description: The Hazard Mitigation Grants program supports initiatives that help communities in Pennsylvania prepare for, respond to, and recover from emergencies and disasters. The program focuses on reducing risks associated with flooding, hazardous materials, and other emergencies. Eligible applicants include counties and municipalities within Pennsylvania. Applications can be submitted through the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency's official channels.
grants.eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include counties and municipalities within Pennsylvania.
key_requirements: Applicants must be located in Pennsylvania.
Projects must focus on disaster risk reduction.
Applications must be submitted through official PEMA channels.

grants.title: Public Assistance Program
grants.summary: Provides funding to help Pennsylvania communities recover from emergencies and disasters.
grants.description: The Public Assistance Program is designed to assist Pennsylvania communities in recovering from emergencies and disasters by providing financial aid for eligible projects. This program supports counties, municipalities, and other eligible entities in rebuilding infrastructure and addressing damages caused by disasters. Applicants must meet specific eligibility criteria and submit required documentation to apply. Funding is available for projects such as debris removal, emergency protective measures, and the repair or replacement of damaged facilities. Interested parties can find more information and apply through the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency (PEMA).
grants.eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include counties, municipalities, and other entities impacted by disasters.
key_requirements: Applicant must be a county, municipality, or eligible entity in Pennsylvania.
Project must address damages caused by a disaster.
Required documentation must be submitted with the application.
